preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is at least 1.

preconditions.expression: all(4 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)])
preconditions.description: Each test case has 4 to 10^5 elements.

preconditions.expression: all(all(-10**9 <= int(x) <= 10**9 for x in input().split()) for _ in range(T))
preconditions.description: Each element in the sequence is between -10^9 and 10^9.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^5.

postconditions.expression: all(len(b) == N for N, b in zip([int(input().split()[0]) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b has the same length N as the input sequence a.

postconditions.expression: all(all(-10**9 <= x <= 10**9 for x in b) for b in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)])
postconditions.description: Each element in the output sequence b is between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(any(all(b[i] - b[i-1] == d for i in range(2, len(b))) for d in {b[1] - b[0], b[2] - b[1]}) for b in [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)])
postconditions.description: The output sequence b is an arithmetic sequence with a common difference d.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for i in range(len(a)) if a[i] != b[i]) <= 1 for a, b in zip([list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)], [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(T)]))
postconditions.description: The output sequence b differs from the input sequence a in at most one position.
